# PitchGrade

> > PitchGrade provides comprehensive business intelligence tools including SWOT analysis, company profiles, financial metrics, and pitch deck resources for startups and investors.

The platform offers detailed competitive analysis and business model breakdowns for public companies, alongside guides for startup fundraising, Y Combinator applications, and content marketing strategies. Founded by Matthew Ramirez and Luciano Colos, PitchGrade serves entrepreneurs, investors, and business analysts with actionable market intelligence.

## Key Topics

- SWOT Analysis
- Business Model Analysis
- Competitive Analysis
- Company Profiling
- Financial Metrics & Performance
- Investment Research
- Y Combinator Applications
- Pitch Deck Creation
- Content Marketing Strategy
- SEO & Lead Generation
- Institutional Investors (Vanguard, BlackRock, State Street)
- Market Capitalization & Revenue Analysis
- Competitive Positioning
- Startup Fundraising
- Company Valuation
